title.rendered: Compost Cleaning With an Allgaier Densimetric Table

content.rendered:
Allgaier densimetric table cleans dirty commpost.

See how dirty compost is screened and then cleaned with a densimetric table from Allgaier. The densimetric table removes most contaminants and specifically targets glass, stone, metal, and hard plastics and plastic stickers (often found on produce). Find out more at https://vdrs.com/composting/
